computerAgent.allowedRootsManageDescription: Folders outside private workspaces that Computer Agent file tools and sandboxed shell commands may access after approval.
computerAgent.allowedRootsShellNote: Shell commands may use the private thread workspace and configured allowed roots on supported platforms.
computerAgent.approvalNeverDangerDescription: AI tool calls can read or change files and, when command execution is enabled, run local commands without a confirmation dialog. Use this only when you trust the active model and conversation.
computerAgent.approvalPolicySelectDescription: Choose how often Biyan asks before Computer Agent tools read files, modify files, or run local commands.
computerAgent.enableDescription: Expose Biyan built-in local file tools to application chats. Enable command execution separately below. Every real action requires one-time approval.
computerAgent.safetyBoundaryDescription: Settings only control prompting and exposed capabilities. Computer Agent tools still stay inside the private workspace or configured allowed roots, and shell commands keep sandbox, timeout, and output limits.
computerAgent.sandboxAccessDescription: Limit Computer Agent tools to read-only access or allow read-write file and command operations inside approved roots.
computerAgent.sandboxReadOnlyNoteDescription: Only directory listing and text-file reading are exposed. File creation, moving, trash, open-path actions, and local shell commands are blocked by the backend.
computerAgent.sandboxReadOnlyNoteTitle: Read-only mode disables writes and commands
computerAgent.shellStatusAvailable: Local command execution is available. When enabled, commands run in a system sandbox, can write only to the current thread workspace and allowed folders, and require approval before each run.
computerAgent.shellStatusInspectFailed: Unable to inspect shell sandbox status.
computerAgent.shellStatusUnknown: Local command execution status is not available.
computerAgent.shellTitle: Allow AI to run local commands
computerAgent.title: Computer Agent
computerAgent.workspaceRootDescription: Biyan stores each chat private agent workspace under this folder.
